law_name: Law No. 2014-038 on the Protection of Personal Data
jurisdiction: Malagasy Commission for Informatics and Liberties (CMIL)
scope: Personal data processed in Madagascar by public and private entities, including foreign businesses operating in Madagascar or using local infrastructure; rights granted to individuals
applies_to: Public and private controllers processing personal data
key_requirements: Consent or other legal basis; prior notification to the CMIL before processing; cross-border transfers only to countries with adequate protection or with CMIL approval
data_categories: Personal data; sensitive data: racial origin, political opinions, religious beliefs, union membership, genetic and biometric data, health, sexual life (prohibited unless legal exceptions apply)
enforcement_authority: Malagasy Commission for Informatics and Liberties (CMIL)
penalties_range: Fines MGA 200,000-10,000,000 for minor infractions; vendor sources also cite up to 5% of pre-tax turnover and imprisonment for severe breaches (secondary sources, statute not checked)
exemptions: Personal or household use; government processing for national security, taxation or law enforcement; journalistic, artistic or academic research processing within legal safeguards
genetic_data: Genetic data is sensitive: processing prohibited unless specific legal exceptions apply (secondary summary; article not cited)
notes: Enforcement long delayed: CMIL structure set by Decree 2023-1541 of 6 Dec 2023; members appointed after Council of Ministers of 30 Jul 2025. Publication date disputed (9 Jun 2015 vs 20 July). Madagascar ratified the Malabo Convention by Law 2024-004.
